explication: Grafana Mimir is a horizontally scalable, multi-tenant long-term metrics platform for Prometheus. The main workflow accepts metric writes, distributes and replicates them to ingesters, persists historical blocks in object storage, and serves PromQL and metadata queries from recent and historical data. Separate branches cover rule evaluation and alerting, plus background block compaction. The README documents these capabilities; the sampled source excerpts are partial, so some subsystem wiring is represented only where the tree and documented product architecture support it.
